Home / Why ENGISOFT

From workforce supply
to engineering intelligence.

Five capabilities that separate a BIM staffing partner from manpower supply.

The ENGISOFT advantage

Five capabilities, one partner.

01 / VERIFIED TALENT

Assessment-backed profiles, not keyword-matched CVs.

Each profile carries role-specific assessment results, verification dates and portfolio review status, so you can see what has been checked.

  • Role-specific technical assessment
  • Timestamped verification records
  • Anonymised until you request an interview
02 / TECHNICAL ASSURANCE

An engineering support layer behind deployed staff.

Deployed professionals can escalate technical questions to a central engineering team for guidance, QA reviews and standards support.

  • Escalation route for model and workflow issues
  • Standardized quality checklists
  • Documented resolution trail
03 / WORKFORCE CONTINUITY

Handover, backup and replacement planning.

Continuity is designed in: handover notes, backup profiles and a defined replacement workflow protect your model and programme.

  • Handover and model status logs
  • Pre-identified backups
  • Defined replacement workflow
04 / DIGITAL WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE

Visibility into availability and deployment.

Availability from timestamped records today, with deployment tracking and portal analytics on the roadmap.

  • Availability from verified records
  • Explainable matching
  • Portal analytics (planned)
05 / CONTINUOUS ENGINEERING DEVELOPMENT

Mentorship, knowledge resources and upskilling.

Engineering mentorship and shared knowledge resources help deployed professionals keep pace with your standards and software.

  • Engineering mentorship
  • Shared knowledge resources
  • Software and standards updates
